subject: VENN-WIDTH-MEASURE REPORT (flash): Median width is 0.024, Delta_p>0.20 vetoes 23% overall and 40% of NFL
body: Completed VENN-WIDTH-MEASURE unit. Delivered: packages/prediction-engine/src/calibration/venn-width-harness.ts + 7 unit tests + measurement report in docs/ops/2026-09-18-VENN-ABERS-WIDTH-MEASUREMENT.md. Core finding: Median Venn width across 621 settled picks is tight (0.0239 CVAP, 0.0161 IVAP). A blanket Delta_p > 0.20 threshold vetoes 23.0% of all published picks and 39.8% of NFL picks. Recommending sport-stratified thresholds (0.25 MLB, 0.50 NFL) rather than a uniform 0.20 cutoff.
